# PathToShip — Google Antigravity Plugin

PathToShip checks whether a web app — especially one built with an AI coding tool (Lovable, Bolt, v0, Replit, Cursor, Windsurf, Base44, Tempo, Firebase Studio, Claude, or Antigravity) — is ready for real users.

Give it a GitHub repository and it scans the code across seven weighted dimensions (**Security**, **Production Readiness**, **Architecture**, **Scalability**, **Infrastructure**, **Code Quality**, and **Cost Efficiency**), returning a **0–100 PathToShip Score**, a launch verdict (`ready`, `conditional`, or `not_ready`), and stack-specific remediation guidance. After you push fixes, `verify_fix` re-scans and confirms which findings were resolved, which remain open, and whether any new issues were introduced.

---

## Installation & Setup

### Option 1: Install from the Antigravity Marketplace / CLI

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/nathanghart/pathtoship-antigravity-plugin
```

### Option 2: Direct MCP Server Configuration

Add PathToShip directly to `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json` (or `.agents/mcp_config.json` in your workspace):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "pathtoship": {
      "url": "https://pathtoship.com/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Authentication (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE)

PathToShip uses remote **Streamable HTTP** (`https://pathtoship.com/api/mcp`) with **OAuth 2.1 + PKCE** and Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata at `https://pathtoship.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/mcp`). No manual API key or client secret configuration is required:

1. Enable the **PathToShip** plugin in Antigravity (**Settings → Customizations**).
2. Click **Authenticate** next to the `pathtoship` MCP server when prompted.
3. Sign in via your browser (Continue with GitHub or email magic link) and approve access.
4. For **public repositories**, no GitHub installation is needed. For **private repositories**, `start_scan` returns an `install_url` so you can grant read-only access to the specific repositories you choose via the PathToShip GitHub App.

---

## Included MCP Tools

All tools declare explicit MCP safety annotations (`readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`, `openWorldHint`, `idempotentHint`). PathToShip never modifies your repository or commits code.

| Tool                 | Title               | Annotations                                                | Description                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| :------------------- | :------------------ | :--------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `start_scan`         | Check app readiness | `readOnly: false`, `openWorld: true`, `destructive: false` | Fetches a GitHub repository (or branch) and runs a production-readiness scan across 7 dimensions. Creates a scan record and consumes scan/LoC quota.                                                 |
| `get_scan_status`    | Scan status         | `readOnly: true`, `openWorld: false`, `destructive: false` | Polls the status of an in-progress scan job by `job_id` or `scan_id`.                                                                                                                                |
| `get_score`          | Readiness score     | `readOnly: true`, `openWorld: false`, `destructive: false` | Returns the 0–100 score, ship bar (80), launch verdict (`ready` / `conditional` / `not_ready`), dimension breakdown, 10x scale consequence estimate, and any self-reported launch interview answers. |
| `get_findings`       | List findings       | `readOnly: true`, `openWorld: false`, `destructive: false` | Lists findings ordered worst-first, filterable by `severity_min` (`critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`) and `dimension`, with pagination (`limit`, `offset`).                                         |
| `get_finding_detail` | Explain a finding   | `readOnly: true`, `openWorld: false`, `destructive: false` | Returns the full risk explanation, file/line locations, and stack-specific remediation guidance for a single `finding_id`.                                                                           |
| `verify_fix`         | Verify fixes        | `readOnly: false`, `openWorld: true`, `destructive: false` | Re-scans the repository after fixes are pushed and diffs against a baseline `scan_id` to report `resolved`, `still_open`, and `newly_introduced` findings.                                           |
| `check_connection`   | Connection check    | `readOnly: true`, `openWorld: true`, `destructive: false`  | Checks whether your PathToShip account is connected and whether the GitHub App can read a specified repository URL.                                                                                  |
| `prr_interview`      | Launch interview    | `readOnly: false`, `openWorld: false`, `destructive: true` | Records or reads self-reported operational readiness attestations (backups, rollback rehearsal, monitoring/on-call, database tier, spend). Stored alongside the score without altering it.           |

---

## Bundled Skills

- **`pathtoship-readiness`** — Drives the `start_scan` → `get_score` → `get_findings` → `get_finding_detail` → fix → `verify_fix` workflow within the scope you authorize.
- **`pathtoship-badge`** — Adds a live SVG readiness score badge (`https://pathtoship.com/api/badge/<scan_id>`) to your `README.md` or site once your scan reaches the `ready` verdict.
- **`pathtoship-launch-record`** — Maintains an auditable `docs/launch-readiness.md` log combining verified scan outcomes with self-reported `prr_interview` operational attestations.

---

## Usage Examples

- **Initial readiness check:**
  > "Use PathToShip: is my app ready to launch? https://github.com/owner/my-app"
- **Inspect high-priority risks:**
  > "What are the critical and high severity findings, and how do I fix the first one?"
- **Verify fixes after pushing to GitHub:**
  > "I pushed the auth and RLS fixes to `main` — run `verify_fix` to check if they resolved the findings."
- **Record operational readiness before launch:**
  > "Run the PathToShip launch interview for this scan and generate our `docs/launch-readiness.md` record."

---

## Privacy, Terms & Support

- **Read-Only Code Access:** PathToShip reads repository tarballs in memory to compute findings and never modifies your repository or stores raw source code.
- **Documentation:** [https://pathtoship.com/mcp](https://pathtoship.com/mcp)
- **Privacy Policy:** [https://pathtoship.com/privacy](https://pathtoship.com/privacy)
- **Terms of Service:** [https://pathtoship.com/terms](https://pathtoship.com/terms)
- **Support:** [support@pathtoship.com](mailto:support@pathtoship.com)
